messages:
alex_w: Heads-up — we're seeing a cluster of 413s on /v1/embeddings from mobile clients. Router trace shows huge JSON arrays (lots of tiny strings) and some SDKs packing ~1.8MB payloads.
ops-bot: alert: embeddings-route: 413 spike (rate: 22/min) — top emitter: mobile-sdk-v2.
mira_s: Are these rejects happening at the API gateway or runtime? Need clear attribution before we change routing logic.
alex_w: Gateway logs: `413 request too large` at ingress. Runtime receives almost none of these, so they get rejected pre-routing.
sam: Quick product check: do quotas count by embedding units (count * dims) or by request bytes? That changes whether we should preemptively reject or let it through.
rachel: Billing/quota is by embedding-units, but our current preflight only enforces dims/token-based checks at runtime. The gateway only sees bytes and currently rejects solely on size. Hence the mismatch.
joni: Suggestion: add size-based routing buckets in the router and map to three paths: fast-path (<=256KB), normal (256KB–1MB), oversized (>1MB) which either gets queued to a best-effort backend or gets explicit fast-fail.
mira_s: +1. Also add a per-tenant soft cap: if bytes/min > threshold, route subsequent requests to normal path to protect p95 latency.
alex_w: Example offending payload pattern:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "rdw-embed-4k",
  "inputs": ["short", "short", ... repeated 2000x]
}
```
Clients batch many tiny texts into one massive request.
sam: SDK change: auto-split when serialized body > 600KB by default; expose `allow_oversize` opt-in. Also add deterministic split boundaries to preserve order.
rachel: Dashboard needs: percentile histogram of request size, 413 rate by tenant, and clear attribution label (ingress vs runtime). Proposed PromQL: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(embed_request_size_bytes_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))` and `sum(rate(embed_413_total[5m])) by (tenant, cause)`.
joni: Rollout UX: Console toggle "Size-aware routing" with canary (5% tenants). Flag: `console.flags.size_route_v1`. Monitor 413, p50/p95 latencies, and cost delta.
mira_s: Note: some customers legitimately need huge batches for offline indexing. Offer a "Bulk Ingest (best-effort)" route with different SLAs and quota semantics. Expose in Console as an opt-in toggle for tenant admins.
sam: SDK sketch for fast-fail/split:
```js
const MAX_BYTES = 600 * 1024;
if (Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(reqBody)) > MAX_BYTES) {
  if (!options.allowOversize) throw new Error('PayloadTooLarge');
  // else split into multiple requests preserving ordering
}
```
alex_w: Telemetry: tag each embed request metric with `ingress_throttle_reason` ∈ [bytes_limit, dims_limit, rate_limit, none] so dashboards can filter quickly.
rachel: I'll add dashboard panels + an alert: `if rate(embed_413_total[5m]) > 5/min AND p95(req_size) > 1MB => create ops ticket` with runbook link.
joni: Implementation plan: 1) router size-buckets + soft-cap (opt-out) 2) console flag + 5% canary 3) SDK auto-split/default MAX_BYTES 4) dashboard + alerts + bulk-ingest route. Owner: @mira_s.
sam: I'll take SDK PR & tests.
mira_s: I'll own router + console flag + telemetry RFC. PTAL: @alex_w @rachel.
alex_w: LGTM. Return structured 413 with header `x-embed-reason: bytes` so clients can show specific UX.
rachel: Runbook updated. I'll ship dashboard prototype tonight. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: deploy started: feature/size-route (canary=5%) -> staging at 1719610100
alex_w: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow if canary shows regressions.
